breaking_news.headline: Kalshi says it's not a sportsbook even as World Cup bets surge
breaking_news.summary: The betting site Kalshi emerged as a dominant sports betting platform during the World Cup. But the company avoids billions of dollars in taxes by insisting it is not a sports gambling operator.

breaking_news.headline: The new $1 Trump coin doesn't just buck norms. Experts say it also breaks laws
breaking_news.summary: President Trump's face will appear on a new commemorative coin honoring the nation's 250th birthday. It's one of the many unusual places his likeness has popped up this year.

breaking_news.headline: China signals possible return of U.S. trade privileges for Hong Kong
breaking_news.summary: The decision comes two months after President Donald Trump met with Xi Jinping, potentially warming ties ahead of Xi's expected U.S. visit.

breaking_news.headline: The 2000s called. They want their digital camera back
breaking_news.summary: Why are people who weren't born 25 years ago snapping up the digital camera of that era? Blame Taylor Swift, trend cycles, childhood nostalgia and smartphone fatigue.

breaking_news.headline: Court ruling freezes Paramount-Warner Bros. merger for now
breaking_news.summary: Paramount's owners were hoping they'd be firmly in control of rival Warner Bros. Discovery by the end of this week. Monday's temporary restraining order puts that plan on hold.

breaking_news.headline: Amid nurse shortage, a university rolls out the welcome mat for men
breaking_news.summary: Only about 1 in 8 nurses are men, but their share is growing. A strong job market for nurses and sustained efforts to recruit men into the field have made a difference, including in the South.

breaking_news.headline: The best economic ideas from around the world — Planet Money Summer School is back
breaking_news.summary: Our free economics course for your ears is on a quest for great economics ideas.

breaking_news.headline: Trump imposes 50% tariffs on Canadian goods
breaking_news.summary: President Donald Trump on Monday imposed 50% tariffs on most Canadian goods, declaring that Canada has unfairly discriminated against American autos, alcohol and dairy products.

breaking_news.headline: Brazil's Amazon sees sharp decline in size of area burned in 2025
breaking_news.summary: The amount of land burned in the world's largest rainforest was the smallest since MapBiomas records began in 1985.

breaking_news.headline: Two French firefighters die tackling blaze near Bordeaux airport
breaking_news.summary: The blaze close to the parking lots at Bordeaux-Mérignac Airport is said to have originated from a brush fire.

breaking_news.headline: Israeli strikes in Gaza kill 12, including family of six, medics say
breaking_news.summary: Firas al-Masri, his wife and their four children died in one attack, which the Israeli military says targeted a Hamas operative.

breaking_news.headline: US launches fresh strikes on Iran, as Trump warns of retaliation for deaths of soldiers
breaking_news.summary: Iran says it has hit two ships in the Strait of Hormuz as well as targets in Bahrain and Jordan.

breaking_news.headline: Dozens hurt in Bologna protests after man dies while being restrained by police
breaking_news.summary: Thousands of people took to the streets demanding justice for a Moroccan-born man who died on Sunday.

breaking_news.headline: Carney looking at 'all options' as Trump announces 50% tariffs on Canada
breaking_news.summary: The duties mark a major escalation in trade tensions between the North American neighbours.

breaking_news.headline: Lebanese army says troops deploying in 'pilot zone' after Israeli withdrawal
breaking_news.summary: A US-brokered agreement should see Israeli troops pulling out of a small part of Lebanon occupied during their conflict with Hezbollah.

breaking_news.headline: Zelensky sacks Ukraine's top army commander after days of protests
breaking_news.summary: Oleksandr Syrskyi is dismissed after days of unrest over the removal of popular Defence Minister Mykhailo Fedorov.

breaking_news.headline: Three reasons why UK electricity prices are so high
breaking_news.summary: The government has announced it will cut VAT on domestic electricity to zero but Britons still pay more for power than many other European nations.

breaking_news.headline: UK borrows less than expected in June but public finances remain a challenge
breaking_news.summary: Public finances for last month were better than expected but the UK is carrying major debt.

breaking_news.headline: The 20-somethings betting big on tech stocks
breaking_news.summary: The BBC hears from people about the risks and rewards of investing in technology shares.

breaking_news.headline: Ryanair broken window may have been caused by 'foreign object'
breaking_news.summary: Passenger Ljubisa Karović was partially sucked out of a cabin window on the Boeing aircraft.
